requirements.quote: Author the explicitly synthetic WSD route model from hk-plumbing-pumps/route-model.json. Preserve its pump, hollow pipe, port and system identities. This fixture is not measured building data.
requirements.acceptance: Author the explicitly synthetic WSD route model from hk-plumbing-pumps/route-model.json. Preserve its pump, hollow pipe, port and system identities. This fixture is not measured building data.

requirements.quote: Query the original saved IFC through official IfcMCP and require the sourced inventory of one pump and two pipe segments.
requirements.acceptance: Query the original saved IFC through official IfcMCP and require the sourced inventory of one pump and two pipe segments.

requirements.quote: Add the supplied sourced review text to the existing pump in a separate saved IFC. Preserve all original entities and do not overwrite an existing property set.
requirements.acceptance: Add the supplied sourced review text to the existing pump in a separate saved IFC. Preserve all original entities and do not overwrite an existing property set.

requirements.quote: Requery the revised saved IFC as a new inventory boundary; retain unchanged source hashes and minimum-count evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Requery the revised saved IFC as a new inventory boundary; retain unchanged source hashes and minimum-count evidence.

requirements.quote: Generate an X/Z pipe centreline schedule and DXF directly from the revised IFC. Reconcile both hollow pipe segments, actual lengths and GUID links. Equipment symbols and installation details remain excluded.
requirements.acceptance: Generate an X/Z pipe centreline schedule and DXF directly from the revised IFC. Reconcile both hollow pipe segments, actual lengths and GUID links. Equipment symbols and installation details remain excluded.

requirements.quote: Save and reopen a native DWG of the revised-model diagram using isolated AutoCAD Core Console. Plot at 1:50 on A4 landscape and verify the 2.5 m reference measures 50 mm. Actual PDF visual review and complete engineering acceptance remain separate.
requirements.acceptance: Save and reopen a native DWG of the revised-model diagram using isolated AutoCAD Core Console. Plot at 1:50 on A4 landscape and verify the 2.5 m reference measures 50 mm. Actual PDF visual review and complete engineering acceptance remain separate.
